summary: GrEnFIn is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in energy markets and green finance run by the University of Bologna, LMU Munich and Université Paris Dauphine. Graduates receive three master's degrees. Up to 51 students are admitted for 2027–2028, and up to 18 receive Erasmus Mundus scholarships of €1,400 a month. Applications close on 7 January 2027 at 11:00 CET.
meta_title: GrEnFIn 2027: Erasmus Mundus energy and green finance master's
meta_description: GrEnFIn gives up to 18 scholarships of €1,400 a month for an energy and green finance master's in Bologna, Munich and Paris. Apply by 7 January 2027.
covers: €1,400 a month for the whole programme, for travel, visa, settling in and living costs.
Scholarship holders skip the tuition payment step when they enrol in Bologna.
Three degrees: Bologna's Greening Energy Market and Finance, LMU's Financial and Insurance Mathematics and Dauphine's Economics and Finance.
eligibility: Applicants from every country, with no more than 10% of scholarships going to one nationality.
A bachelor's degree in mathematics, physics, economics, statistics, information technology or engineering. Other subjects are not eligible.
English at B2. Only nationals or graduates of the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland and the UK are exempt, so applicants from Ghana or Nigeria need a certificate; online tests are accepted.
Final-year students can apply and be admitted on condition.
how_to_apply: Register on the University of Bologna's Studenti Online and apply to one of the three tracks: Renewable Technologies, Environmental Finance, or Climate & Business.

Upload your passport, the programme's ISCED classification template (Excel), your degree and transcript translated into English, proof of B2 English and a Europass CV. GRE or GMAT scores are optional.

Submit by 7 January 2027 at 11:00 CET. Academic merit counts for 60 points, experience for 30 and GRE or GMAT for 10; 60 points makes you eligible and 80 earns an interview, which decides the scholarships.
Results are published on 26 February 2027, and places and scholarships are accepted from 1 to 5 March 2027.
watch_out: Missing or half-uploaded documents at the deadline mean your application is not considered. Nothing is accepted by post or email.
If you are invited to interview and do not attend, you lose any chance of a scholarship.
Scholarship holders cannot hold another EU-funded scholarship for the same course.
documents: Degree and transcript, translated into English

faq.a: 7 January 2027 at 11:00 CET. Results come out on 26 February 2027.
Yes. Engineering is one of the eligible bachelor's subjects, with mathematics, physics, economics, statistics and information technology.

faq.q: How many GrEnFIn scholarships are there?
faq.a: Up to 18 Erasmus Mundus scholarships of €1,400 a month for 2027–2028, among up to 51 places.
